## Historical work-stage proposal disposition

**Amend** the bound planner proposal. The original task remains external
contract/support closure; the proposal and its advisory review are evidence.
No stage deltas were supplied. Live entry validation found 55 inherited rows,
31 terminal, 24 open and zero invalid. APG140 and exit 00185 were available.

The amendments address every supplied plan finding:

1. Evaluate the exact migration condition and record its source-bound state;
   do not reject the skill while silently retaining UNKNOWN. Independent review
   must adjudicate this state transition before closure.
2. Use semantic public observations `APG140-RM-MAIN-20260912` and
   `APG140-JACA-MAIN-20260912`, with publication-excluded exact revision and
   content bindings. Repo Map QUALIFIED means APGR-local fixture qualification
   only; JACA HANDOFF_CLOSED describes provider ownership, not adoption.
3. Give RM-S0, RM-S4 and RM-S5 explicit support-package rollback evidence.
4. Map migration obligations to all five frozen process-owner prerequisites,
   including reasoned non-applicability for Bash-to-Python conversion.
5. Extend disposable closure-repository construction for new fixture/evidence
   references and register the new mirrored test owner. Preserve historical
   accounting tests while adding synthetic 43-terminal/12-open cases.
6. Present complete outcome-specific receipt candidates and compatibility rows
   for pre-final review. Reviewer fields remain null, and all twelve actual
   closure rows remain OPEN. Closeout must bind actual supplied review evidence
   and disclose its later mechanical terminalization.

The work-stage envelope supersedes the proposal's Git finalization procedure:
the producer does not stage, commit, push, choose reviewers or perform closeout.
